name: Payment Response 8
definition: Data to respond to a payment request.

SaleTransactionIdentification.name: Sale Transaction Identification
SaleTransactionIdentification.definition: Sale System identification of the transaction in an unambiguous way.

SaleReferenceIdentification.name: Sale Reference Identification
SaleReferenceIdentification.definition: Global reference of the sale transaction for the sale system.

POITransactionIdentification.name: POI Transaction Identification
POITransactionIdentification.definition: POI identification of the transaction in an unambiguous way.

POIReconciliationIdentification.name: POI Reconciliation Identification
POIReconciliationIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the reconciliation period between the acceptor and the acquirer.

IssuerReferenceData.name: Issuer Reference Data
IssuerReferenceData.definition: Identification of the transaction given by the Issuer.

RetailerPaymentResult.name: Retailer Payment Result
RetailerPaymentResult.definition: Data related to the result of a processed payment transaction.

LoyaltyResult.name: Loyalty Result
LoyaltyResult.definition: Data related to the result of a processed loyalty transaction.

CustomerOrder.name: Customer Order
CustomerOrder.definition: Customer order attached to a customer, recorded in the POI system.
